headline: Tesla's Cybercab comes with ownership restrictions and monthly fee
summary: Tesla has invited some buyers to reserve a personal Cybercab robotaxi, priced at $30,000 plus a $299 monthly fee, with Tesla able to restrict where the vehicles drive and block owners from reselling them.

sources.quote: The electric-auto maker says it has invited some buyers to reserve a personal robotaxi.
